authoritative_species_evidence.source: National Museum of Nature and Science Japan thistle database
supported: ordinary flowers are nodding at anthesis and become upright after flowering
upright-flowering plants are reported from multiple localities
white-flowered plants are recognized as Shirobana-kiseruazami
authoritative_species_evidence.boundary: No locality-specific co-segregation of white/non-white and anthesis-upright/nodding is established.

evidence: C. sieboldii herbarium records from former Tsukude-mura (Iwanami and Higashitahara)
local field flora reports abundant C. sieboldii in Mikawa wetlands
hairy and nearly glabrous plants reported together in the Tsukude Plateau region
tsukude_aichi.route_role: priority locality set for dense intraspecific-variation census; not evidence of orientation or colour co-segregation

cs0_priority: Kurumayama Moor / Kirigamine: verify white vs non-white frequency and record A1-A2 orientation opportunistically from permitted paths
Kiyooka-Mukaiyama Wetland, Tsukude: run the primary standardized A1-A2 orientation census and prospectively screen colour
Kashibaru Wetland, Saga: third-priority upright-flowering validation only, with explicit taxonomic-mixture screening
Other localities only if these routes are not identifiable
decision.reason: Public sources establish both trait dimensions somewhere in the species but do not establish same-population or tightly matched local-set co-segregation.
decision.orientation_prior_update: Local-area and population-level records make true anthesis-orientation variation plausible; CS_RED_PHENOLOGY should not be assumed a priori, but same-population focal-species verification remains required.

hard_boundaries: post-anthesis upright heads are not upright-flowering morphs
white-form locality does not imply orientation polymorphism
regional morphological variation does not imply combinatorial segregation
no Nature natural-reassembly claim before same-individual CS census

kurumayama_moor.restriction: Natural Monument wetland; entry and plant collection are prohibited without appropriate authorization.
kurumayama_moor.implication: High biological priority for white-form verification, but census completeness may be limited by visibility from permitted paths.

kiyooka_mukaiyama.restriction: Observation infrastructure is present; no tissue collection is implied by Gate CS.
kiyooka_mukaiyama.implication: Highest practical priority for standardized A1-A2 orientation census and prospective colour screening.

naganoyama.restriction: Wetland interior is roped off and entry is not allowed; designated Natural Monument.
naganoyama.implication: Lower CS0 priority than Kiyooka-Mukaiyama for a 20-30 individual standardized census.

kashibaru.restriction: Saga Natural Environment Conservation Area; plant collection prohibited; some zones inaccessible.
kashibaru.implication: Useful third-priority orientation-validation site if taxonomic verification can be done non-destructively. Not first choice for the colour x orientation gate.

local_orientation_evidence.evidence: The observer reports flowering C. sieboldii in one nearby rural area and explicitly notes that some plants flower with a straight peduncle rather than nodding.
local_orientation_evidence.limitation: Exact revisit locality is not published; cannot be an operational CS0 site from this source alone.

local_orientation_evidence.evidence: Local flowering report states that most flowering Maa-azami (identified there as Kiseru-azami) were upward-facing and horizontal heads were rare.
local_orientation_evidence.limitation: The wetland flora also lists Satsuma-maa-azami; individual-level taxonomic verification is mandatory before treating this as focal C. sieboldii.
